Subject: [ILUG] 3Ware Driver Issue Ubuntu Feisty

Hi all,
Just wanted to ask if anyone has encountered issues with using a 3Ware 
raid card under Ubuntu Feisty. We (Redbrick) recently got a new Encom 
storage server and there's severe disk io issues with it.

There's a report on launchpad similar to the issue, 
https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/linux-source-2.6.20/+bug/113532 
 So I was wondering if it would be worth rolling our own dapper kernel 
with the 3ware driver, or if there's a better solution?

The reason we're using feisty btw, is that it has the 3ware driver builtin.

Thanks,
Redbrick Admins.
